meta.title: Oh! Music tools, starting with Oh-a-Chord
meta.description: Oh! makes music software. Oh-a-Chord: press any key, play a chord. Out now on the App Store. Two more tools on the way.

hero.line: Music tools from one person who makes records with them. Oh-a-Chord is out now on the App Store. Press any key. Play a chord.

chord.status: Out now on the App Store
chord.headline: Press any key. Play a chord.
chord.body: Oh-a-Chord is an experimental chord generating app for iPad and iPhone. It helps you break out of your songwriting rut and find interesting new chords.

comingSoon.heading: More from Oh!
comingSoon.body: Oh a Comber is out now for Mac. Oh a Synth is still in progress. Leave your email and you'll hear when it ships. One message. Nothing else.

synth.blurb: A 6-voice polysynth inspired by the classic sounds of the 80s.
synth.mailtoLabel: Tell me when Oh a Synth ships

comber.blurb: A sample organizer that makes every sample you already own findable, without moving a file. Free.

maker.heading: Who makes this
maker.body: Oh! is Nate Mueller. Designer, developer, and the first user of everything here. Records music as Oacoma.
